events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
This is a rider-side cancellation on an instant booking (RydeX, non-metered), so the only route into a $6.61 cancellation fee is NS-4 via NS-0: cancelled_by = rider [F2][NS-0]. NS-4 charges the fee only when the rider cancels more than 3 minutes after matching; here acceptance was 18:23:00 and cancellation at 18:25:30, i.e. 2 min 30 s = 150 s [F2], which is within the 3-minute free window (≤ 3:00). The fee therefore does not arise, and the $6.61 already taken [F5] must be returned in full → refund_full of $6.61 [F2][F5][NS-4].

The no-show branch does not apply and would not save the charge in any event: NS-1 requires the driver to have tapped "I'm Here", to have been within the pickup range on GPS, and to have waited over 3 minutes. The driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F4], no arrival was recorded [F3], and the closest the driver ever came to the pickup was 1806 m, never inside 200 m [F1]. So none of NS-1(i)–(iii) is satisfied, and independently the fee could not stand.

The trace's ✗ on NS-4 confirms the 150 s interval, and its allowed outcomes limit me to refund_full or escalate; the safety screen is the only open question [F7][F8][F9][F10]. The driver's explanation after the fact — "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" [F10] — is a statement, and system records (GPS/timeline) override statements on this point [F1][F3][F4]; it does not make the fee chargeable, and it is not evidence of a threat or abuse.

Safety screen: I read both chat messages, the complaint and the driver statement. The rider asks "How long will you be?" [F7]; the driver replies "About 5 min, traffic" [F8] — an ordinary ETA exchange, complete and timestamped [F9]. The complaint is a fee grievance only. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation anywhere in the record, so safety_concern = none and no referral under SAFE-1 / SAFE-2 is needed. Since the record (complete chat, full timeline, GPS) settles every element of NS-4, no part of this case is undetermined and no escalation is warranted.
